### Risk Factors
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'asis'

# Should this only be for the target?
  

# TODO restrict to T and O cohorts of interest
targetIds <- cohortDefinitions %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$cohortDefinitionId %in% targetIdsOfInterest) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$order, .data$cohortDefinitionId) %>%
  dplyr::pull("cohortDefinitionId")

caseIds <- OhdsiReportGenerator::getCharacterizationCaseSettings(
  connectionHandler = connectionHandler,
  schema = params$schema,
  targetIds = unique(targetIds),
  outcomeIds = outcomeIdsOfInterest
)


if(!is.null(caseIds) && nrow(caseIds) > 0){

  caseIds <- caseIds %>% 
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      tar = paste0("(", .data$startAnchor, " + ", .data$riskWindowStart, ") - (",
      .data$endAnchor, " + ", .data$riskWindowEnd, ")")
    )

  
  for(caseId in caseIds$characterizationCaseId){

    ind <- which(caseIds$characterizationCaseId == caseId)
    # need to run this per t and o and settings
    riskFactorsBinary <- OhdsiReportGenerator::getBinaryRiskFactors(
      connectionHandler = connectionHandler, 
      schema = params$schema, 
      characterizationCaseId = caseId, 
      analysisIds = c(1,4,5,210,410)
    )
    
    notNull <- !is.null(riskFactorsBinary)
    hasRows <- FALSE
    if(notNull){
      hasRows <- nrow(riskFactorsBinary) > 0 
    }
    if(notNull & hasRows ){
    riskFactorsBinary <- OhdsiReportGenerator::formatBinaryCovariateName(riskFactorsBinary)


      # get all the settings
      limitToFirstInNDays <- caseIds[ind,]$limitToFirstInNDays
      minPriorObservation <- caseIds[ind,]$minPriorObservation
      nestingName <- caseIds[ind,]$nestingName
      minAge <- caseIds[ind,]$minAge
      maxAge <- caseIds[ind,]$maxAge
      studyStart <- caseIds[ind,]$studyStart
      studyEnd <- caseIds[ind,]$studyEnd
      genderConceptIds <- caseIds[ind,]$genderConceptIds
      outcomeWashoutDays <- caseIds[ind,]$outcomeWashoutDays
      tar <- caseIds[ind,]$tar
      
      #TODO: add the other target settings in the text
      boxTitle <- paste0(
          'Risk Factors for ', 
          cohortDefinitions$friendlyName[cohortDefinitions$cohortDefinitionId == caseIds$outcomeId[ind]],
          ' occuring for the first time in ',
          outcomeWashoutDays,
          ' days during ',
          tar,
          ' for patients exposed to ',
          cohortDefinitions$friendlyName[cohortDefinitions$cohortDefinitionId == caseIds$targetId[ind]], ' ' 
          , cohortDefinitions$subsetText[cohortDefinitions$cohortDefinitionId == caseIds$targetId[ind]],
          ' nested in cohort ', nestingName, 
          ' exposed for the first time in ',  limitToFirstInNDays , ' days',
          ' with >= ', minPriorObservation, ' days prior observation',
          ' aged between ', minAge, ' - ', maxAge,
          ' index starting between ', studyStart , ' and ', studyEnd,
          ' with gender conceptIds restricted to ', genderConceptIds
        )
      
      # print the binary risk factors in a collapseable box
      writeLines("")
      writeLines("")
      writeLines("::: {.callout-note collapse=true}")
      cat(paste0("\n# ",boxTitle, '\n\n'))
      
      temp <- riskFactorsBinary %>%
          dplyr::arrange(-1*.data$absSmd) %>%
          dplyr::filter(
            .data$absSmd > 0.1,
            .data$caseCount >= 0 # make this an input?
          ) %>%
          head(
            n = 200 # select top 200
          ) %>%
         dplyr::select(
          "covariateName",
          "databaseName",
          "caseCount", 
          "caseAverage",
          "nonCaseCount", 
          "nonCaseAverage",
          "smd", 
          "absSmd"
          )

         print(htmltools::tagList(
    temp %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$covariateName) %>%
      gt::gt() %>%
      gt::fmt_percent(
        columns = c("caseAverage","nonCaseAverage"), 
        decimals = 2
      ) %>%
      gt::fmt_number(
        columns = c("smd", "absSmd"), 
        decimals = 2
      ) %>%
      gt::fmt_integer(
        columns = c("caseCount", "nonCaseCount")
      ) %>%
      gt::cols_label(
        covariateName = "Covariate"
      ) %>%
      gt::tab_options(
        heading.align = "left",
        data_row.padding = gt::px(7),
        column_labels.font.size = gt::px(12),
        column_labels.background.color = "#EB1800",
        column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
        row_group.background.color = "#D3D3D3",
        row_group.font.weight = "bold"
      ) %>%
      gt::tab_style(
        style = gt::cell_text(
          color = "darkgrey",
          font = gt::google_font("Source Sans Pro"),
          transform = "uppercase"
        ),
        locations = gt::cells_column_labels(gt::everything())
      ) 
  ))
  
      writeLines("")
      writeLines("")
      writeLines(":::")
      writeLines("")
      
    }}} else{
      writeLines("")
      writeLines("")
      writeLines("::: {.callout-note collapse=true}")
      cat(paste0("\n# No risk factors \n\n"))
      cat("\n\n No risk factors for the target of interest")
      writeLines("")
      writeLines("")
      writeLines(":::")
      writeLines("")
    }
```
